title: Evaluation of one XOR step
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ variables, and let $p,q$ be pairs of Boolean circuit trees on those variables. Suppose the second circuit in each pair evaluates under $x$ to the negation of the first. Then the first circuit in the pair produced by one XOR step evaluates to the exclusive OR of the first circuits in $p$ and $q$.
